notes.title: DEMO 1.0.4 Update Notes
notes.content:
Here comes another major demo update!

Some more great feedback came my way, and I am committed to provide the best experience possible. Thanks you all again for your involvement!

[previewyoutube=ExMOuTZHJEw;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are the major changes:

[list]
[*] Made the first 15 minutes more meaningful and dynamic 
[*] Shorten path to first dialogue, first ability and combat
[*] Added new collectible / resource: Crystals
[*] New feature: Crystal Rings
[*] New feature: Resurrection Points
[*] Added a Stasis Ability gating mechanism
[*] Reworked and added dialogues that provide better understanding of the storyline and the player's goal
[*] Reworked the main character's animations (more dynamic and stylised)
[*] Polished the overall game quality (main menu / vfx / sfx / hud / environment dressing..)
[*] Tweaked game balance
[*] Fixed Keyboard rebinding
[/list]

More news to come soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715870/Before_I_Go/

notes.title: DEMO 1.0.3 Update Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837944/d78021e39376bf9f6a6dc87a36022694a4c1972c.png[/img]

Fellow gamers,

BEFORE I GO got an incredible boost during the Next Fest! Thanks you all for playing, for the wishlists, and the support!

I can't be more happy for all the demo feedback I received. And as a solo developer, this is priceless to me. 

Today, I released the 1.0.3 demo update. Alongside minor improvements, this update addresses some of the most recurrent feedback from players and brings an overall better experience to the first hour of the game.

[h1]Major changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Temple Elevation Relic moved so it can't be missable
[*] Added an Elevation Relic in the Soma Forest, earlier in the game
[*] Fast travel between Elevation Relics
[*] Stasis ability radically buffed (now completely stops enemies and projectiles)
[*] Basic navigation tutorial shortened
[*] Added new collectibles: Fireflies
[*] New map feature : markers
[*] Keyboard rebinding options
[/list]

[h1]Other changes / fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Music not paused when opening the map
[*] First boss projectiles more legible
[*] Main character animations polished
[*] Main character material polished
[*] Removed some obstructing geometry
[*] Map tutorial message not displayed if the map was already opened
[*] Fixed some french typos
[*] Different post effect mood in the north temple section
[*] Increased energy recharge rate
[*] D-pad also bound to the main character navigation
[*] Fixed Elevation Relic money display
[/list]


Thanks you again for the feedback, this is extremely useful!

The journey goes on!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715870/Before_I_Go/

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hi fellow gamers!

A lot is going on right now, and I couldn't be more excited to announce that BEFORE I GO will be participating in the Steam Next Fest June 2024 Edition!

Are you ready to outbrave the game's first chunk? Have a go at the demo from June 10!

If you want to get a sense of what awaits you, check out the demo teaser:

[previewyoutube=96ceL6QJ0Xw;full][/previewyoutube]

I aim to support as many languages as I can for the full game. Right now, I managed to get the demo playable in 3 languages: English, French and Italian. Will keep you posted when more localization work goes in.

I can't wait for you to get your hands on it!
Exciting times!
